subject: Marketplace bundle revenue & lead registration — term alignment
messages:
From: Devon Li <devon@integrix.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@integrix.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-01-17T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft commercial terms for IntegraX marketplace bundle

Rishi / Marissa —

Thanks for sending the draft earlier. We went through it with our commercial team and have three quick asks before we take this to legal: 

1) Revenue split on bundled deals: can we clarify how credits are attributed when a customer purchases the bundle (IntegraX + Redwood managed infra)? Our ask: 60/40 in favor of the party owning the primary invoice for the first 12 months, with a 50/50 on renewals unless there is a documented service uplift.

2) Lead registration window: we need a 120-day proof-of-intro window for pipeline qualification. We can shorten in high-volume pilots but want the protection for named accounts.

3) Clawback language: 90-day clawback for churn attributable to pre-existing contracts only (i.e., not for buyer-initiated downsizing).

Attached is a redline of Annex A that shows our starting markup ("IntegraX_Annex_A_revshare_v1.docx"). Happy to hop on a short call this week.

Best,
Devon
Head of Partnerships, IntegraX

Attachments: IntegraX_Annex_A_revshare_v1.docx (docx stub)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Devon Li <devon@integrix.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-01-17T10:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft commercial terms for IntegraX marketplace bundle

Devon —

Thanks for the clear asks and the redline. Quick reactions from our side before we produce a counter-redline: 

- Revenue split: we can agree to the "first invoice owner" approach for the pilot phase (first 12 months), but we want a deterministic attribution rule for multi-line invoices. Proposal: attribute by product SKU lines; if Redwood-managed infra SKU >50% of ARR then Redwood receives the primary share. This avoids ambiguity on blended invoices.

- Lead registration window: 120 days is reasonable, but we require a warm-intro clause (email thread or calendar invite) to qualify. For named account exceptions (enterprises), we can expand to 180 days with C-suite confirmation.

- Clawback: 90-day clawback is acceptable if it excludes customer-side force majeure and company acquisitions. We should add a pro-rata refund schedule for partial-month terminations.

Next steps: Marissa and Karthik will review the Annex redline and produce a joint draft. Can you confirm if IntegraX needs exclusive introductions in North America for the first 6 months? That affects our GTM commitments.

I'll loop Camila on ops details (billing and invoicing).

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Alliances — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Devon Li <devon@integrix.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-01-18T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft commercial terms for IntegraX marketplace bundle

Devon / team —

We reviewed Annex A. Key edits are focused on operational clarity so this can be executed without back-and-forth: 

- Attribution: added SKU-level attribution examples and a fallback formula for blended invoices. See section 2.1 in the redline.

- Proof docs for intro: expanded acceptable proof types (email, calendar invite, CRM lead id) so we don't get stuck on format.

- Billing cadence & invoicing: consolidated into a single schedule — Redwood will invoice IntegraX monthly for Redwood-owned share; IntegraX invoices for their share. We added a net-30 payment term with a dispute escalation path to prevent delayed revenue recognition.

- Pilot incentives: included a one-time "demo credit" of $12k Redwood credits to be applied to the first pilot invoice if both parties commit to a 6-month proof-of-value.

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx) with milestones and responsibilities. Please review and flag any operational blockers.

Marissa
Head of Partner Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (xlsx stub)
From: Devon Li <devon@integrix.com>

Date: 2028-01-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft commercial terms for IntegraX marketplace bundle

Marissa / Rishi —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the draft MAP. Quick confirmations from IntegraX legal/commercial: 

- No exclusivity required for NA; we just asked to understand Redwood's marketing cadence so we can align co-marketing.

- Demo credit: agreed — we'll sign the MAP and confirm the 6-month POV milestone.

- Lead registration: 120-day window with the expanded proof types is fine. We'll add a clause to allow retroactive crediting if CRM id is created within 14 days of the intro email.

We don't have major redlines to the clawback language; we'll accept the pro-rata schedule. Please send the consolidated Annex A and the MAP back as a single package and we'll route to our exec sponsor for sign-off.

Next week works for a 30-minute alignment call (preferred Tuesday).

Thanks —
Devon
Head of Partnerships, IntegraX
